finalText:
**Big, but mostly safe.** 1291 hits in 94 files.

| Zone | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services` JS names | 1075 | yes |
| `services` SQL strings | 125 | no |
| [migrations](migrations) | 61 | no |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 20 | no |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | no |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js#L8) `WIRE` | 5 | left key only |

Four zones are frozen. The DB column is still `account_id`. Those migrations already ran in production. Vendor is overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`. `openapi.yaml` is the public contract. One more trap sits in [repo/invoice.js:35](services/billing/src/repo/invoice.js#L35). It writes the key into stored `payload` JSON.

Next: sign off on the 1075 JS names only.
